concept.title: Multilateral non-trivial cross-intersection product bound
concept.concept_description: For every n,k,r with n ≥ 2k, k ≥ 3, and r ≥ 2, let (𝓕_i)_{i∈Fin r} be k-uniform families of subsets of Fin n.
